technical.summary: BKR shows overbought momentum conditions with bullish short-term structure but lacks trend confirmation (weak ADX), long-term alignment, and actionable entry signals; elevated risk of pullback given stochastic bearish cross and overbought extremes.

fundamental.summary: BKR shows no fundamental momentum: zero insider activity, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 95 days present elevated risk.

sentiment.summary: Weak congressional selling pressure from junior member; extreme market fear (26/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity despite bearish AAII sentiment (56.2%).

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (325.28) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar pressures multinational energy revenues, and earnings in 95 days adds event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme market fear (VIX crisis, 26/100 fear-greed) creates contrarian opportunity with stock near support (23.04) and short-term momentum (RSI overbought, price above EMA 9/21) suggesting potential bounce.
debate.key_bear_argument: Fundamental collapse (score 2), macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, strong dollar, recession signals), stochastic bearish cross, weak ADX trend confirmation, price below 200-EMA, and no triggered strategies create high-probability pullback risk with earnings event risk in 95 days.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme market fear creates contrarian setup, but fundamental collapse (score 2), macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis), and stochastic bearish cross eliminate conviction. Risk/reward unfavourable.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings event in 95 days combined with inverted yield curve recession signals and weak ADX trend confirmation create high probability of pullback below current support.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bearish bias despite contrarian sentiment opportunity
